package mcp

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"example.com/agentfixture/internal/application/usecases"
)

// Reads is the seam the MCP server is built over.
type Reads interface {
	Fleet(ctx context.Context, id string) (usecases.FleetView, error)
	Robot(ctx context.Context, id string) (usecases.FleetView, error)
}

// Server answers read tools only.
type Server struct{ reads Reads }

// NewServer builds the server.
func NewServer(r Reads) *Server { return &Server{reads: r} }

func (s *Server) fleet(ctx context.Context, id string) (string, error) {
	v, err := s.reads.Fleet(ctx, id)
	if errors.Is(err, usecases.ErrFleetNotFound) {
		return "not found", nil
	}
	return v.Name, err
}
